Riyadh, October 25, 2026, SPA -- The Asian Football Confederation (AFC) announced today the postponement of the match between Saudi Arabia's Al-Nassr and the UAE's Al-Wasl, originally scheduled for tomorrow, Monday, as part of the third round of the AFC Champions League Elite.
    In a statement published on its official website, the AFC said the match would be rescheduled, with the new date and kickoff time to be announced later.
    -- SPA

news.og_desc:
Riyadh, October 26, 2026, SPA -- Official Spokesperson for the Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen Major General Turki Al-Malki stated that two ballistic missile launchers were destroyed in Sanaa, one of which was used to launch the ballistic missile toward Riyadh.
    Major General Al-Malki said, "Operations continue to dismantle the terrorist Houthi militia's ballistic missile network."

news.og_title: Arab Interior Ministers Council Condemns Houthi Attacks Targeting Makkah and Madinah Regions
news.og_desc: The General Secretariat of the Council of Arab Interior Ministers has strongly condemned the terrorist attacks carried out by the Houthi militia using missiles and UAVs against civilians, civilian objects, and holy sites in Saudi Arabia. In a statement issued from its headquarters in Tunis, the secretariat also condemned the militia's recent attempt to target Makkah and Madinah regions with ballistic missiles, which were intercepted and destroyed by Saudi air defenses, SPA reported.
